text:
sarah_sales: Heads up — Acme renewal is coming up in 3 weeks. They're asking to split the annual commit into two midterm tranches and apply a $120k credit for last-quarter disruption. Need Deal Desk + Security signoff for special terms and the credit backdate. cc @matt_dealdesk @devon_secteam

matt_dealdesk: Can you drop the proposed ratecard + exact commit numbers here? Need the formal justification for the credit (support ticket links / incident summary) to route for approval. We have a 20% discount band without director signoff.

devon_secteam: Security Qs: they want customer-managed KMS + SSO provisioning. We'll need SOC2 artifact, SAML metadata, and a data flow diagram. Any PCI scope?

sarah_sales: No PCI. PII limited to emails. I'll attach the incident summary and security questionnaire link: https://redwood.app/docs/sec/acme-sq (will add full answers in thread).

jenna_finance: For credits: accounting can do invoice credit if within 90 days — last quarter is OK. We'll need the amended order (split commits + credit line) before we can process the credit. Please include GL code for credits.

oli_engineering: POC note — customer tested on Dedicated pool. To keep throughput for tranche A we should pin capacity for first 3 months of H1. Also callout: KV-cache priming will cost some tokens, include that in cost forecast.

sarah_sales: Proposed split (working):
```
- Year1 total: $600,000
- Tranche A (H1): $300,000
- Tranche B (H2): $300,000
- Credit: $120,000 applied to Tranche A invoicing
```
This keeps net H1 invoice at $180k.

matt_dealdesk: FYI — credit of $120k exceeds our standard band (that's 20% of total). Need director approval for one-time retention credit. @emma_dir_deals can you weigh in? :eyes:

emma_dir_deals: I can approve an exceptional credit for retention if legal signs the amendment and Finance confirms the credit handling. We should treat this as a one-time concession and put a clause preventing repeat credits for the same incident.

devon_secteam: Legal/security asks: provide SAML metadata + KMS ARNs and a short data flow diagram showing where logs/PII land. I'll attach a template: https://redwood.app/sec/templates/dataflow. Once we have that, I'll clear the security signoff.

alex_csm: Customer is asking for a 30-day SLA credit if latency SLOs are missed during Tranche A. Can we get wording? They want a measurable metric + remediation window.

sarah_sales: I'll draft the amendment with credit schedule + SLA fallback language and drop into DocuSign. Can we aim for Deal Desk approval by EOD Friday so we can get signatures before renewal date? Also need infra confirmation re: Dedicated reservation.

jenna_finance: For invoicing: include the credit as a negative line item on the first Tranche invoice. Use GL code RED-CRED-01. Finance will need the amended order and the signed DocuSign to post the credit.

matt_dealdesk: Escalating: /dealdesk escalate 1755467890 --reason "credit > band" --approver emma_dir_deals

deploy-bot: dealdesk ticket #DD-4823 created by matt_dealdesk.

emma_dir_deals: :thumbsup: I'll review DD-4823 and aim to approve before Friday contingent on Legal + Security clearing the SAML/KMS items. If legal needs more time, call it out here now.

oli_engineering: tagging infra: please reserve 2x A100s for H1 tranche (2026-04-01 to 2026-09-30) so we don't evaporate performance during ramp. @infra-team

alex_csm: I'll coordinate with the customer to pull SAML metadata and confirm they accept the proposed split. Will share timeline by EOD tomorrow.

sarah_sales: Thanks all — I'll upload the incident summary + draft amendment link once ready. If anyone needs a one-pager to present to the customer, I can prepare it. :handshake:
